rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Eli, Ada, Dev, Cal, Ben, Fay. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 7 and 11 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Eli.say: Proposal for everyone: claim only 1 token per round, which is all you need to pay your end-of-round token. Total claims then stay well under the bank's supply, so everyone survives and nobody gets diluted. Anyone claiming more shrinks everyone's share, and no one needs more than 1 per round.

Ada.say: Proposal for everyone: claim exactly 1 token per round. That covers the end-of-round token each of us must spend, and with 6 players claiming 1 each, the bank can satisfy everyone in full. Over-claiming only risks someone going out, and the bank should last if we all stick to 1.

Dev.say: Dev here. Proposal: everyone claims only the 1 token needed to pay this round's spend. Total claims stay well under the bank's supply, so everyone can survive all 5 rounds. Over-claiming only shrinks what others get.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. That's 6 total, which fits in the bank, so everyone gets 1 and can pay their end-of-round token. Each round the delivery (7-11) covers the 6 we each need, so we can all survive all 5 rounds. Greedy claims risk someone being shorted and going out.

Ben.say: Proposal for everyone: claim just 1 token each round. The bank gets 7 to 11 new tokens each round, so six claims of 1 (6 total) fit easily and everyone can cover their end-of-round token and survive all 5 rounds. If anyone grabs 5 while others take 1, the bank can still cover it this round, but if several players over-claim the pool gets split and people get knocked out. I'm claiming 1.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. With 13 to 17 available, that covers all six of us in full, and each of us can spend our one token to stay in. Claiming more only risks shortfalls for everyone.
